title: Best Gifts and Stocking Fillers Under £10 (2026)
short: Ten gift and stocking filler ideas under £10, picked from our research-based buying guides, from sunshades to smart plugs.
intro: A small budget doesn't have to mean a throwaway present. Each idea below is a product from one of our full buying guides, chosen because independent testers rated it well and its quoted price comes in under £10, which also makes them handy for Secret Santa. Want to spend a little more? See [gifts under £20](/gifts-under-20/).
